context: Evaluates the use of mathjs bitwise operations for bit manipulation tasks.

checklist.name: setBit implementation
checklist.description: Uses bitOr() with leftShift() to set a specific bit to 1

checklist.name: clearBit implementation
checklist.description: Uses bitAnd() with bitNot() and leftShift() to clear a specific bit to 0

checklist.name: extractBits implementation
checklist.description: Uses rightArithShift() or rightLogShift() and bitAnd() to extract bit ranges
